findings.summary: `--standing-rule` rejects only `\n`, and the schema pattern `^[^\n]+$` has the same gap. An internal carriage return, for example `--standing-rule $'allowed\r- injected rule'`, is accepted and kept. A purported one-line rule could then render as several lines in a prompt file on consumers that treat CR as a line break. Reject `\r` as well, or validate against a no-line-break expression. The same check applies in `projectStandingRules` in `prompt-rules.js`.
